The Load Control module L.C 2.4 (A20) will be in service after phasing the unit and 
its function to control the difference between the target load signal and the 
desired load signal. This 
Module is intended for the control of the turbo set output by means of 
 turbine governor valves

This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.

The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, 
tested by
eng. Ashraf Farid at 29 May 2003, 
revised by quality control EDEPCo. eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam, accepted by general 
director: eng. Aly Abd El-Whab, and approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy; Head 
Sector of Talkha Power Station.

Power Stations
Technical Procedure
Introduction
The Load Control module L.C 2.4 (A20) will be in service after phasing the unit and 
its function to control the difference between the target load signal and the 
desired load signal. This 
Module is intended for the control of the turbo set output by means of 
 turbine governor valves
This document outlines the testing procedure P1, 
which performed every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, 
tested by
eng. Ashraf Farid at 29 May 2003, 
revised by quality control EDEPCo. eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam, accepted by general 
director: eng. Aly Abd El-Whab, and approved by eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy; Head 
Sector of Talkha Power Station.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
maintenance staff should be carry the
suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks 
surrounding the work area, 
is required
Wear your safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
